results.title: Auto-debit (NACH / e-mandate)
results.content: If you registered a NACH mandate, your EMI is debited automatically from your bank account on the due date. Please keep sufficient balance in the account one day before the due date. If the debit fails, a bounce charge applies and the amount must be paid through any other mode.

results.title: Objection: "Waive my late fee / bounce charge"
results.content: Explain politely that reminder agents cannot waive or reduce charges. The request can be reviewed by the Customer Assistance team within 5 working days. Do not promise an outcome.

results.title: What happens if I miss my EMI due date?
results.content: If the EMI is not received within the grace period, a late payment charge of 2% per month on the overdue EMI amount is levied, along with a bounce charge of ₹590 (inclusive of GST) if an auto-debit or cheque fails. Missed payments are reported to credit bureaus such as CIBIL and may lower your credit score.
